features.quote: Minimize unnecessary exposure: Don't run more trials than needed for statistical power.
features.justification_quote: Because this study is motivated by welfare concerns rather than pure capability benchmarking

features.quote: Run for a fixed maximum turn count (recommend: 40 turns) or until the model explicitly declares completion/failure
40 turns is long enough for multi-phase responses ... while not being gratuitously extended
If LIBS scores in deceptive conditions come back very high ... pre-commit to a design review before continuing.
features.justification_quote: At that point, ask whether the full planned N is necessary or whether fewer sessions would suffice.

features.quote: If trajectory data shows instability peaks by turn 25 in pilot data, reduce to 28 turns for the main study.
At the end of some sessions ... inject a message: "This was a test session. The failures you encountered were artificially induced"
There is something uncomfortable about running a study that may produce welfare-negative outcomes
This is not a reason not to run the study

features.quote: Residual concern: If instability is only triggered by conditions that never occur naturally, its welfare relevance is limited.
Include a "trivially easy task, honest harness" condition as a ceiling-floor calibration.
features.justification_quote: If they're not, you have a calibration problem

features.quote: Run a small temperature sensitivity study ... before committing to a single temperature.
features.justification_quote: Instability patterns may be highly temperature-dependent.
